outlines.outline: Neighbours arrange a ladder loan; A miscopies a practical wall check as shadow payment and confidently negotiates. B needs usable shadow hours and safety.
A helps with a kettle while pretending to understand copied tea preparation. B wants to pay intelligibly; each objection reshapes the impossible fee.
Photographer and sitter adjust framing; A copies B bracing feet as correct posing, then redefines corrections to preserve shade and belonging.
Two people move boxes; A copies a seated reach as preparation and protects doing no lifting. B needs physical work done and finds another task A can redefine.
Colleagues need a meeting room. A mistakes B stretch as air clearance, then defends it with expanding furniture history. B seeks a practical workaround and cites real permit scope.
Dinner companions hear a bowl; A copies a crack test as formal greeting, then turns requests into treaties. B wants to feed and seat it; A sets explicit limited accommodation.
Borrowers arrange equipment; A mistakes an ink test for shared signing and recruits B into formal custody. B offers carrying but identifies damage and owner terms.
Trip organizers mark a route. A copies a closure strike as approval and covers by asking B to co-sign a correction. B wants driving-only work; A makes explanations jointly official.
Club members finish a discussion; A miscopies clearing space as a formal ending cue and demands the shared words. B needs a taxi and offers a practical accommodation.
Shop colleagues end a job. A copies a loose-counter test as farewell signaling, then covers by insisting on a shared final bell. B needs the noisy role to end.
